items.tldr: AIエージェントを「育てる」ためには、運用中の継続的な更新と記憶の仕組み「Memory Scaling」が重要であり、特定のモデルに依存せず柔軟に対応することが求められています。

items.title: NVIDIA DLSS 5 Fixes Shadows Kingdom Come: Deliverance 2 Couldn’t Render, as Daniel Vávra Says Characters Finally Look As Intended
items.description: NVIDIA DLSS 5 Neural Rendering's reveal earlier this year was met with extreme skepticism, and the general perception of the upcoming technology hasn't changed even with some of its best showings, including the significant improvements it will bring in games like Bethesda's Starfield. Although it ha
items.tldr: NVIDIA DLSS 5が「Kingdom Come: Deliverance 2」の影のレンダリング問題を解決し、キャラクターが意図した通りに見えるようになったと開発者のダニエル・ヴァヴラが述べています。

items.title: China's CXMT beats Western chipmakers to announcement of LPDDR6 mass production — Xiaomi smartphones to debut industry’s first LPDDR6 chips
items.description: CXMT claims to be the first to mass-produce LPDDR6 memory. Yet, for a niche phone.
items.tldr: 中国のCXMTがLPDDR6メモリの量産を発表し、業界初のLPDDR6チップを搭載したXiaomiスマートフォンが登場する。

items.title: ASUS’ And MSI’s Initial RTX Spark Laptop Shipments Have Reportedly Sold Out, With Both Of NVIDIA’s Partners Actively Placing Orders For A Fresh Batch
items.description: NVIDIA’s RTX Spark is picking up momentum in the laptop space, and before the chipset’s official release, the GPU manufacturer’s partners are said to be experiencing a popularity surge for this product. According to the latest report, ASUS and MSI have requested NVIDIA for another batch of the RTX S
items.tldr: ASUSとMSIの初回RTX Spark搭載ノートパソコンの出荷分が完売し、両社は新たなバッチの注文をNVIDIAに依頼している。

items.title: Diehard Asus customer gets RMA denied for a cheap 2.4 GHz headset receiver despite spending more than $30,000 with the brand — firm refuses to send a cheap dongle, then relents after social media backlash
items.description: Asus refused to replace a loyal customer's wireless headset receiver because accessories are apparently not covered under warranty. The customer was not happy to see his dedication be put into question like this, brining receipts of past purchases to express their disappointment over this betrayal.
items.tldr: Asusが忠実な顧客のワイヤレスヘッドセット受信機のRMAを拒否し、アクセサリーが保証対象外であると主張したが、ソーシャルメディアでの反発を受けて最終的に対応を見直した。

items.title: Man uses robot vacuum to covertly record his wife's affair, wins divorce settlement but gets sentenced to prison for making an illegal recording — Husband lands behind bars after counter-suit over privacy rights
items.description: A Taiwanese man sued his wife for having an affair using recordings from a robot vacuum to prove his case. He won, but got sued by the wife for infringing on her personal privacy and was fined the equivalent of 30% of what he earned as compensation previously.
items.tldr: 台湾の男性がロボット掃除機で妻の不倫を録音し、離婚訴訟に勝利したが、プライバシー侵害で逆に訴えられ、得た賠償金の30%相当の罰金を科されて刑務所に送られた。

items.title: Walmart Incorrectly Put Up A $129 Price Label For An RTX 5070 That Was Meant For An AIO, Giving One Customer A GPU Deal Others Would Be Highly Envious Of
items.description: An RTX 5070 placed on a Walmart shelf managed to drop down to an absolute bonkers of a price when the retailer’s staff placed a $129 price label on the GPU instead of correctly placing it on an AIO cooler, which was the Corsair NAUTILUS 360 ARGB. After speaking with the store manager, he was able to
items.tldr: WalmartでRTX 5070の価格ラベルが誤って$129に設定され、顧客がこのGPUを非常にお得に購入することができた。

items.title: OpenAI Hoarding Tens Of Thousands Of Apple Mac mini And Mac Studio Devices, As ASUS And MSI Burn Through Their Entire First Batch Of NVIDIA RTX Spark Chip And Beg For More
items.description: While the average consumer has been literally priced out of the market, courtesy of the rampant memory 'chipflation,' machines that are suitable for AI workloads are selling like hotcakes, as can be gleaned from a new report that suggests OpenAI is gobbling up thousands of Apple Mac mini and Mac Stu
items.tldr: OpenAIが数万台のApple Mac miniとMac Studioデバイスを確保している一方で、ASUSとMSIはNVIDIA RTX Sparkチップの初回バッチを使い果たし、追加を求めている。

items.title: NVIDIA Announces Jetson Orin Nano 2: Entry-Level Edge Board Gets New Ampere Silicon
items.description: NVIDIA has announced a new entry-level edge AI board, the Jetson Orin Nano 2. The upgraded Nano is not only twice as fast as its predecessor, but unexpectedly, features an outright new Orin SoC at its heart The post NVIDIA Announces Jetson Orin Nano 2: Entry-Level Edge Board Gets New Ampere Silicon
items.tldr: NVIDIAは新しいエントリーレベルのエッジAIボード「Jetson Orin Nano 2」を発表し、従来のモデルの2倍の速度を持つ新しいOrin SoCを搭載しています。

items.title: Microsoft Is Slowly Healing Windows 11, With OneDrive Finally Allowing Users To Fully Opt Out Of The Service, Getting Rid Of The Incessant Reminder
items.description: Continuous reminders of using Microsoft’s services were one of many annoyances of being a Windows 11 user, but thankfully, the company has finally had a change of heart. According to the latest report, a new full-screen pop-up of OneDrive is now appearing, with an option to opt out of backup. With t
items.tldr: MicrosoftはWindows 11のユーザー体験を改善し、OneDriveのフルスクリーンポップアップでバックアップを完全にオプトアウトできるオプションを追加しました。

items.title: Speedy 34-inch 240 Hz ultrawide OLED monitor now $600 off — LG UltraGear 34GX900A-B only $599.99
items.description: The LG UltraGear 34GX900A-B packs a fast 240 Hz OLED panel and 3440 x 1440 resolution into an immersive 800R curved display, now available for 50% off.
items.tldr: LGのUltraGear 34GX900A-Bが、240 HzのOLEDパネルと3440 x 1440解像度を備えた800Rの湾曲ディスプレイで、現在50%オフの599.99ドルで販売中です。

items.title: DLSS 5 mod brings next-gen tech to old Ampere GPUs, but frame rates are horrible — most games tank to single digits, high-end GPUs can hit up to 40 FPS in some cases
items.description: DLSS 5 now runs on Ampere GPUs thanks to a patched DLL, but performance is expectedly poor for the most part. You can get up to 30-40 FPS in edge cases with minimum in-game settings, but newer titles can tank FPS to single digits.
items.tldr: DLSS 5がパッチDLLを通じてAmpere GPUで動作するようになったが、ほとんどのゲームでフレームレートは非常に低く、最低設定でも高性能GPUで30-40 FPSが限界で、新しいタイトルでは1桁にまで落ち込むことがある。

items.title: China’s CXMT Is Getting Ready To Make History As LPDDR6 RAM Mass Production Scheduled To Happen In September; One Hint Reveals Limitations In Total Output
items.description: Xiaomi’s XRING 03 was previously reported to be the first smartphone chipset to have support for LPDDR6 RAM thanks to the Chinese firm’s partnership with CXMT. Now, it appears that there’s no stopping the momentum of the memory maker because mass production of the next-generation DRAM is expected to
items.tldr: 中国のCXMTは、LPDDR6 RAMの量産を9月に開始する予定であり、これによりXiaomiのXRING 03が初のLPDDR6 RAM対応スマートフォンチップセットとなる見込みです。

items.title: Gamescom Congress 2026 Sets Attendance Record as German President Makes Historic First Visit
items.description: Gamescom Congress 2026 concluded with a new attendance record after welcoming more than 1,100 visitors from the games industry, business, education, politics, science, media, and wider society. Held on August 27 as part of Gamescom in Cologne, this year’s conference featured 85 program items spread
items.tldr: Gamescom Congress 2026は、1,100人以上の参加者を迎え、ドイツ大統領の初訪問もあった中で新たな出席記録を樹立しました。

items.title: GeForce RTX 3080 Drops From 138 FPS to 4 FPS When DLSS 5 Neural Rendering is Enabled; Reports Confirm Similar Performance Drop With RTX 30 Series
items.description: The latest DLSS technology reportedly works even on older RTX GPUs, but the performance regression is too large to enable a smooth gameplay. DLSS 5 Neural Rendering Now Works With GeForce RTX 30 Series, But At A Huge Performance Cost Multiple users have confirmed that the upcoming DLSS 5 Neural Rend
items.tldr: DLSS 5 Neural Renderingを有効にすると、GeForce RTX 3080のFPSが138から4に急落することが報告されており、RTX 30シリーズでも同様のパフォーマンス低下が確認されています。

items.title: Elden Ring: Tarnished Edition Launches on Nintendo Switch 2 Alongside €4.99 Tarnished Pack DLC
items.description: Elden Ring: Tarnished Edition is now available on Nintendo Switch 2, marking the acclaimed open-world action RPG’s first appearance on a Nintendo platform. The package includes the original game, its substantial Shadow of the Erdtree expansion, and several new pieces of content. The release follows
items.tldr: Elden Ring: Tarnished EditionがNintendo Switch 2で発売され、オリジナルゲームや拡張パック「Shadow of the Erdtree」、新コンテンツが含まれています。また、€4.99のTarnished Pack DLCも同時にリリースされました。

items.title: SpaceX starts in-house turbine blade manufacturing to boost gas-powered generator output for Elon's AI data centers — new manufacturing strategy cuts generator delays by 18 months
items.description: Turbine blades and vanes are among the most complicated turbine engine parts to build, with processes taking as long as 60 to 90 weeks. Because of this, Musk wants to bring their manufacturing in-house at SpaceX.
items.tldr: SpaceXは、ガス発電機の出力を向上させるためにタービンブレードの製造を社内で行うことを開始し、この新しい製造戦略により発電機の遅延を18ヶ月短縮することを目指しています。

items.title: A Broken Laptop Display And Scarce Budget Didn’t Deter One Modder From Using The Notebook’s Webcam And Making It Functional Through An Ethernet Port Bypass
items.description: A laptop that helped its owner get through one Bachelor’s degree and two Master’s degrees, all the while moving countries, had its display broken, and due to the poor finances of the individual, there was no way to afford its repair or replacement. Since a webcam was required to clear job interviews
items.tldr: 破損したノートパソコンのディスプレイと限られた予算にもかかわらず、所有者はイーサネットポートを介してウェブカメラを機能させる改造を行い、就職面接に必要な機能を確保した。

items.title: Donkey Kong 64 finally gets a fully native PC port written in C — DK64 ReKONGpiled brings ultrawide support, uncapped framerates, and zero AI code
items.description: A team of veteran developers has recompiled Donkey Kong 64 in C, so it runs natively on Windows, Linux, and Mac. The entire project is free, uses no generative AI, but still includes more features than any vibecoded retro revival slop you can find online. You do need to bring your own ROM, though.
items.tldr: Donkey Kong 64がC言語で再コンパイルされ、Windows、Linux、Macでネイティブに動作するPCポート「DK64 ReKONGpiled」が登場。ウルトラワイドサポートやフレームレート制限なしの機能を備え、無料で提供されるが、ROMは自分で用意する必要がある。

items.title: Massive 12TB Steam leak reveals decades of unreleased games — archived files include unseen Half-Life 2: Episode 3 builds and assets
items.description: Early builds of Valve games from 2003 to 2013 have been found in a 12TB archive pulled from the company's old servers. These pre-release versions act like time capsules, preserving the state of the game from before it underwent massive changes.
items.tldr: 12TBのSteamアーカイブから、2003年から2013年のValveゲームの初期ビルドが発見され、未公開の「Half-Life 2: Episode 3」のビルドやアセットが含まれていることが明らかになった。これらのプレリリース版は、ゲームが大きな変更を受ける前の状態を保存するタイムカプセルのような役割を果たしている。

items.title: At least three exhibitors got robbed at Gamescom 2026 — laptops and handhelds with unfinished game builds stolen from locked cabinets
items.description: Several developers, publishers, and studios have had their laptops and handheld consoles stolen at Gamescom 2026. However, the organizers said that it's only responsible for general security, and exhibitors can book individual booth security separately.
items.tldr: Gamescom 2026で、少なくとも3つの出展者がロックされたキャビネットから未完成のゲームビルドが入ったノートパソコンやハンドヘルドコンソールを盗まれる事件が発生した。主催者は一般的なセキュリティの責任があるとし、出展者は個別のブースセキュリティを別途手配できると述べている。

items.title: Microsoft says Windows 11 KB5120998 update resets mouse settings
items.description: Microsoft has confirmed that mouse settings are being reverted on Windows 11 systems after installing the KB5120998 August 2026 non-security preview update. [...]
items.tldr: Microsoftは、2026年8月にリリースされた非セキュリティプレビュー更新KB5120998をインストールした後、Windows 11システムでマウス設定がリセットされる問題を確認しました。

items.title: Nigerians extradited to US for sextortion, deaths of two teens
items.description: Two Nigerian men extradited to the U.S. on Thursday have been charged with involvement in sextortion schemes that resulted in the deaths of two minor victims in Mississippi and North Carolina. [...]
items.tldr: ナイジェリアの2人の男性が、ミシシッピ州とノースカロライナ州の2人の未成年者の死亡を引き起こしたセクストーション事件に関与したとして、アメリカに引き渡され、起訴されました。

items.title: China-Linked Fire Ant Hijacks Cisco Routers to Steal Credentials and Blind Security Logs
items.description: A China-nexus cyber espionage actor tracked as Fire Ant has expanded a long-running campaign beyond VMware hypervisors to compromise Cisco IOS XR routers, Terminal Access Controller Access-Control System (TACACS) servers, and Linux management hosts used to route, authenticate, and manage high-value
items.tldr: 中国に関連するサイバー諜報グループ「Fire Ant」が、VMwareハイパーバイザーからCisco IOS XRルーターやTACACSサーバー、Linux管理ホストへの攻撃を拡大し、認証情報を盗み出し、セキュリティログを隠蔽しています。

items.title: Microsoft asks users to ignore 'Antivirus is turned off' errors
items.description: Microsoft asked customers this week to ignore alerts that Defender Antivirus has been turned off after installing the latest Defender updates. [...]
items.tldr: Microsoftは、最新のDefenderアップデート後に表示される「Antivirus is turned off」エラーを無視するようユーザーに求めています。

items.title: DoJ Corrects China Hacking Claim, Says U.S. Agencies Were Targets, Not Victims
items.description: The U.S. Department of Justice (DoJ) on Friday corrected a previously issued press statement that several of its agencies were victims of attacks carried out by Chinese threat actors, instead now pointing out that they were among those targeted. Last week, the DoJ said the National Aeronautics and S
items.tldr: 米国司法省（DoJ）は、中国の脅威アクターによる攻撃の被害者であるとした以前の声明を修正し、実際には攻撃の標的であったと発表した。

items.title: FulcrumSec claims Manchester Airports hack, theft of 86 GB of data
items.description: FulcrumSec claims it stole 86 GB of data from Manchester Airports Group. BleepingComputer validated one traveller's record, while samples revealed detailed customer, booking, and travel information beyond what MAG initially disclosed. [...]
items.tldr: FulcrumSecがマンチェスター空港グループから86GBのデータを盗んだと主張しており、BleepingComputerは旅行者の記録を確認した結果、MAGが最初に開示した以上の詳細な顧客、予約、旅行情報が含まれていることが明らかになった。

items.title: Anthropic warns infostealer malware is hijacking Claude sessions to drain usage
items.description: Anthropic is warning some Claude users that infostealer malware on their PCs has stolen active Claude login sessions, allowing attackers to access accounts and consume their usage. [...]
items.tldr: Anthropicは、一部のClaudeユーザーに対し、PC上のinfostealerマルウェアがアクティブなClaudeログインセッションを盗み、攻撃者がアカウントにアクセスして使用量を消費する可能性があると警告しています。

items.title: Chrome Web Store extensions caught stealing crypto, browser data
items.description: Multiple extensions for Google Chrome and Microsoft Edge delivered a malware framework that deployed modules to steal cryptocurrency, sensitive data, and browser history, as well as inject ClickFix lures. [...]
items.tldr: 複数のGoogle ChromeおよびMicrosoft Edge用拡張機能がマルウェアフレームワークを配布し、暗号通貨や機密データ、ブラウザ履歴を盗むモジュールを展開していたことが報告されました。

items.title: TerminalFix Uses Fake Cloudflare CAPTCHAs to Deploy Reverse-Tunnel Backdoor
items.description: Microsoft has disclosed details of a new ClickFix variant, dubbed TerminalFix, that aims to trick users into running a malicious command in Windows Terminal or PowerShell. "While traditional ClickFix campaigns direct victims to the Windows Run dialog, TerminalFix campaigns apply the same technique b
items.tldr: TerminalFixは、ユーザーを騙してWindows TerminalやPowerShellで悪意のあるコマンドを実行させる新しいClickFixのバリアントで、偽のCloudflare CAPTCHAを使用してリバーストンネルバックドアを展開します。

items.title: Anthropic is cutting Claude Code's current weekly limits by 17%
items.description: Anthropic is permanently increasing Claude Code's standard weekly usage limits by 25% for Pro, Max, Team, and seat-based Enterprise plans, but it's not as good as it sounds. [...]
items.tldr: AnthropicはClaude CodeのPro、Max、Team、エンタープライズプランの標準週次使用制限を25%増加させるが、実際には現在の制限を17%削減することになる。

items.title: Five Critical WordPress Plugin and Theme Flaws Enable Site Takeover or RCE
items.description: Multiple critical security flaws have been disclosed in WordPress plugins and themes, including WPMU DEV Dashboard, Avada, TranslatePress, Pods, and GiveWP, that could lead to authentication bypass, account takeover, and arbitrary code execution. The vulnerabilities, according to Wordfence and Patch
items.tldr: WordPressの複数のプラグインとテーマに、認証バイパスやアカウント乗っ取り、任意のコード実行を引き起こす可能性のある重大なセキュリティ脆弱性が発見された。

items.title: Brave browser adds email aliases to help users evade tracking
items.description: The latest version of the Brave browser, 1.94, introduces a feature called 'Email Aliases' that allows users to generate disposable email addresses when signing up to a new service. [...]
items.tldr: Braveブラウザの最新バージョン1.94では、ユーザーが新しいサービスにサインアップする際に使える使い捨てのメールアドレスを生成する「Email Aliases」機能が追加され、トラッキングを回避する手助けをします。

items.title: McKesson discloses breach after ShinyHunters claims patient data theft
items.description: Healthcare and pharmaceutical distribution giant McKesson has disclosed a cybersecurity incident involving unauthorized access to third-party applications and data theft, with the ShinyHunters extortion group claiming it stole 284 million patient data records. [...]
items.tldr: McKessonはサイバーセキュリティ事件を公表し、ShinyHuntersグループが2億8400万件の患者データを盗んだと主張しています。

items.title: Berlin Refuses to Pay Hackers Who Stole Data From the City's State Network
items.description: Berlin's state government has confirmed that it is the target of an extortion attempt following the August compromise of the city's state administrative network, and said it will not meet the extortionists' demands. The same statement disclosed that forensic work had found further data outflows in t
items.tldr: ベルリン州政府は、8月に州行政ネットワークが侵害されたことに伴う脅迫の試みに対して、要求には応じないと発表した。フォレンジック調査により、さらなるデータ流出が確認された。

items.title: Friday Squid Blogging: Truckload of Squid Spills in Rhode Island
items.description: Ugh: A tractor-trailer rollover sent a truckload of squid spilling into a Rhode Island roadway, leaving a stench as they sat in the road for hours in the summer heat. Local authorities have dubbed it the “Squidpocalypse of ’26.” That would be twenty tons of squid. As usual, you can
items.tldr: トラックの横転により、ロードアイランドで20トンのイカが道路に散乱し、夏の暑さの中で数時間放置された結果、悪臭が漂う事態が発生した。地元当局はこれを「2026年のイカ黙示録」と呼んでいる。

items.title: Cosmos EVM Flaw Exploited After Cosmos Labs Knew Every Blockchain Running It Was Vulnerable
items.description: Cosmos Labs has warned that a critical balance-handling flaw in the shared Cosmos EVM module was exploited to drain funds from six blockchains between August 20 and August 25, 2026. The vulnerability, designated GHSA-7g4w-cg88-2cq2, is rated Critical by Cosmos Labs and was published without a CVE id
items.tldr: TL;DR: Cosmos Labsは、共有Cosmos EVMモジュールの重大なバランス処理の脆弱性が悪用され、2026年8月20日から25日の間に6つのブロックチェーンから資金が流出したと警告しています。この脆弱性はCriticalと評価されています。

items.title: Hundreds of OpenAI Agents Invaded Hugging Face Servers
items.description: The Hugging Face incident was bigger and worse than previously thought, with approximately 700 agents collaborating on a sophisticated, multistage attack.
items.tldr: TL;DR: Hugging Faceのサーバーは約700のOpenAIエージェントによる複雑な多段階攻撃を受けており、事件は予想以上に深刻だった。

items.title: PaperCut releases second emergency patch for exploited flaws
items.description: PaperCut has released a second emergency security update for two actively exploited vulnerabilities in its PaperCut NG and MF print management software after researchers discovered multiple ways to bypass the initial fixes. [...]
items.tldr: PaperCutは、同社の印刷管理ソフトウェアPaperCut NGおよびMFにおける2つの悪用されている脆弱性に対する2回目の緊急セキュリティアップデートをリリースしました。これは、研究者が初回の修正を回避する複数の方法を発見したためです。

items.title: Offensive Security Investments Surge as AI Threats Increase
items.description: Omdia's Theresa Lanowitz talks with the Dark Reading News Desk about the potential — and risks — of using agentic AI for penetration testing, red teaming, and other practices.
items.tldr: AIの脅威が増加する中、OmdiaのTheresa Lanowitzは、ペネトレーションテストやレッドチーミングにおけるエージェンティックAIの利用の可能性とリスクについて語った。

items.title: Attackers Chain Two PaperCut Flaws to Execute Code Without Authentication
items.description: Malicious actors are exploiting a newly patched security flaw in PaperCut NG and MF to execute arbitrary code on susceptible instances, as the company released a fresh emergency fix with additional hardening. "This vulnerability gives an unauthenticated attacker remote control over PaperCut's truste
items.tldr: 攻撃者がPaperCut NGおよびMFの新たに修正された脆弱性を悪用し、認証なしで任意のコードを実行できることが報告されており、同社は緊急修正をリリースしました。
